beats.text: Vibhishana whispered the secret: 'Ravana's life is hidden in the nectar in his navel.'
Matali reminded Rama of the Brahmastra, the weapon of Brahma, given to Rama by Agastya.
Its feathers were the wind, its tip was fire and sun, and its weight was like the mountains Meru and Mandara.
Rama chanted a mantra and released it.
The arrow found its mark, and the mighty king of Lanka fell.
The gods showered flowers. The sun shone clear. The wind blew softly again over Lanka.
Even then, Rama asked Vibhishana to give his brother a proper funeral. 'Enmity ends when life ends,' he said. 'He is as much my brother now as yours.'
Vibhishana was crowned king of Lanka, as Rama had promised.
